On Friday evenings, Kate reviews the notes from class. The lantern street looked quieter than usual that evening. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Also, the children stayed busy with coloring books on the train.

The holiday plan has become an important part of daily life. Kate thanked Anna for the honest advice. Kate will take part in a badminton match in November. They found good noodles in a backstreet cafe near the station.

Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Kate keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. The experience taught Kate more than any book could. Best of all, he drinks tea without sugar.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Anna advised Kate to try singing as a new hobby. At first, Kate found it difficult to keep the habit. For example, open the window for fresh air.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Kate believes that trying new things keeps life fresh.
